j.applique.placementInset.title: Distance of the placement line inside the edge (Punch: 1–1.5 mm)
j.applique.freeEdge.title: Free-edge appliqué: placement 5 mm inside the edge, no tack-down, one stop for the spray glue and the fabric, then the cover
j.foam.name: Satin over 3D foam
j.foam.title: Satin sewn over a foam sheet: 3D relief. A stop before the object to lay the foam; sew it last
j.foam.hint: Satin only, no fill underlay: straight-stitch contour (and a centre walk from 4 mm), denser satin, caps on the open ends. The machine stops first to lay the foam.
j.foam.spacing.title: The normal satin's spacing; over foam the stitches are denser: {mm} mm
j.foam.contourPasses.title: Straight-stitch contour: 1 pass, 2 at most
j.foam.densityFactor.title: Divides the normal satin's spacing (1.45: provisional, to check at the first stitch-out)
j.foam.caps.title: They close the open ends (T, L, E) on the shape's edge, so the foam does not stick out
j.foam.sheetNote: 3D foam: ballpoint needle, softer tension, never put the foam in the hoop, not for children's clothing.
